content.subject: Month‑end close automation hypothesis
content.draft_text:
Hi Jon,
Your appointment as CFO follows experience guiding companies through IPOs. I suspect month‑end close suffers from manual matching across systems, adding delays and errors for the finance team and operations. We connect your ledgers to a single engine that auto‑reconciles entries, eliminating manual cross‑checks. Would a short 15‑minute conversation next week fit your schedule to explore this?
Zamp
